nested_test_shell.note: Default OFF: a crash of a nested test shell (gnome-shell or mutter started with --headless, --virtual-monitor or --nested) is routed like any other crash at its normal severity and is tagged nested-test-shell for the agent's context. Set exempt to true in the user override file to drop those crashes to the audit log only (no event, no agent). The nested-shell isolation helper of hyperdock (issue 44) already keeps these crashes away from the desktop; loop protection is dedup, rate limit, spawn caps and backoff in agent-sub.
